decisions.reason: The yogurt on fruit puree sits close to the firm's core cultured-dairy knowledge and won the eathealthy Award, so management can read its results and refine it.
The flavoured Abendbrotkäse builds on the firm's cheese know-how and was featured on the home page, so the firm can learn from early sales and improve it.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is very close to the established range, so the firm can readily assimilate market feedback.
The spicy cheese builds on existing cheese knowledge, though as a flavour variant it carries somewhat higher risk of rationalisation within a narrow range.
The mild creamy soft cheese rounds out the new range and relies on related dairy expertise, which supports its continuation.
The washed-rind soft cheese still builds on the firm's cheese base, but its more specialised ripening and niche appeal make it somewhat more likely to be dropped.
